title: Days-Late Add-On in the LandlordGuard Collections Timetable
content:
**Timetable.** The days-late add-on of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy late fee counts calendar days from the late installment's due date to the charge date: more than 20 days adds 5.00 USD; more than 12 up to 20 days adds 2.50 USD; 12 days or fewer adds nothing.

The add-on is added in the late-fee adjustment. The late installment is the most recently billed installment, and its due date is the one shown on that billed installment.

| Calendar days from the due date to the charge date | Days-late add-on |
|---|---|
| more than 20 | 5.00 USD |
| 13 to 20 | 2.50 USD |
| 12 or fewer | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical installment due 1 March)

| Charge date | Days after the due date | Add-on |
|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 12 | nothing |
| 14 March | 13 | 2.50 USD |
| 21 March | 20 | 2.50 USD |
| 22 March | 21 | 5.00 USD |
